provider: CUHK Department of Geography and Resource Management 2025-26 Major requirement and 2025-26/2026-27 course list
academicYear: 2025-26 Major requirement; 2025-26 and tentative 2026-27 offerings; reviewed on 2026-07-29
note: The official 2025-26 recommended pattern defines a regular four-year Major of at least 63 GRMD units: six named ordinary required courses including the fixed Faculty Package course GRMD1401, three required Field Studies courses, two Final Year Thesis courses, and twelve elective courses. Together those eleven required courses account for 27 units and the twelve electives account for 36 units. The Faculty Package is 9 units in total and also requires two courses from different departments or schools, so it is not closed by this department-only list. This supplement exposes the union of 55 codes in the official 2025-26 and tentative 2026-27 offering list and seven additional GRMD3012-GRMD3018 field-trip electives published in the current Programme Overview. The latter seven are official Programme courses but are not marked as offered in the two-year offering PDF. The four optional Concentrations and their named minimum-course conditions are preserved in course groups. Only GRMD1401, GRMD1403 and GRMD1011 have directly published per-course units in the reviewed sources; all other courses use credits 0 to mean unknown and are not inferred from group totals. The separate 54-unit senior-entry path, the two open Faculty Package courses, individual credits, and complete elective completion paths are not closed by publicly accessible evidence. The resulting 62-course list is intentionally browse-only and must not produce a graduation completion percentage.
